title: Cervical Changes
content: The cervix changes position and texture throughout the cycle. Around ovulation, it typically becomes higher, softer, and more open (often summarized by the acronym SHOW: Soft, High, Open, Wet). After ovulation and during menstruation, it becomes lower, firmer, and closed. Cervical mucus also changes from dry/sticky to creamy, and finally to clear/stretchy during the fertile window.
